title: Using Poly-Encoders for Computationally Efficient Automated Creativity Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2608.26165v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated creativity assessment has been a long standing challenge, with traditional methods often being resource intensive or lacking practical accuracy. We introduce a novel approach by using Poly-Encoder for computationally efficient and accurate automated creativity assessment. We fine-tuned a Poly-Encoder on a public dataset from the Scientific Creative Thinking Test, comprised of approximately 18,000 human-rated question responses. Our method leverages small pre-trained BERT encoders, achieving performance comparable to fine-tuned Large Language Models while significantly reducing computational demands. Experiments with the BERT-family models and poly-code counts achieved Pearson correlations of up to r = 0.74, 95% CI [0.73, 0.75] with human raters, matching the performance of resource intensive LLMs. This study bridges the gap between high performance and computational efficiency, potentially enabling widespread implementation o

translated_title: 使用多编码器进行计算高效的自动化创造力评估
translated_abstract: 自动化创造力评估一直是一个长期挑战，传统方法往往资源密集或缺乏实际准确性。我们引入了一种新颖的方法，使用Poly-Encoder进行计算高效且准确的自动化创造力评估。我们在一个来自科学创造性思维测试的公开数据集上微调了Poly-Encoder，该数据集包含约18,000个人工评分的问题回答。我们的方法利用小型预训练的BERT编码器，实现了与微调大型语言模型相当的性能，同时显著降低了计算需求。使用BERT系列模型和多编码数量的实验，与人类评分者的皮尔逊相关系数最高达到r = 0.74，95%置信区间[0.73, 0.75]，与资源密集型LLM的性能相匹配。这项研究弥合了高性能与计算效率之间的差距，可能促进其广泛实施。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Poly-Encoder的自动化创造力评估方法，利用小型BERT编码器在保持与大型语言模型相当性能的同时显著降低计算成本。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a Poly-Encoder-based method for automated creativity assessment, leveraging small BERT encoders to achieve performance comparable to large language models while significantly reducing computational costs.
